items.label: What's here
items.title: Four pieces of work since 1.2.1
items.lede: Lumen 1.2.1 shipped on 6 Nov. Since then: search is ready, a sync fix needs one change, sharing links are parked, and the 1.3 launch page waits on search. None of it is on GitHub yet.

rows.title: Conflicting edits are lost in 1.2.1
rows.text: The fix works, but its banner can't be dismissed. One small change, then it can ship as 1.2.2.

rows.title: Search is ready
rows.text: Fast on 4,000 notes, including PDF text. Ready to carry over.

rows.title: The launch page promises search
rows.text: Ship it with 1.3, after search carries over.

rows.title: Sharing links
rows.text: Parked until there's a server to host the links.

items.label: Search
items.title: Search: find any note as you type
items.lede: A search field at the top of the sidebar. Results appear as you type, with the matching words highlighted, and the text inside PDF attachments counts too.

callouts.p: Tried on 4,000 notes and 300 PDFs: results in under 50 ms, and the index adds about 2% to the library's size.

blocks.label: The biggest commit, in pieces
rows: SearchField and SearchResults: a text field, and a list fed by the on-device index.
The sidebar shows results instead of the note list while there's text in the field.

blocks.label: Usage count
rows: One counter for searches. It stays on this Mac, like the existing ones.

rows.title: Type a word you know is in a PDF
rows.text: It should show up with the match highlighted.

rows.title: Clear the field
rows.text: The full note list comes back.

bullets: On-device index, built when a note is saved, so typing never waits on the disk.
Results replace the note list while there's text in the field.
PDF text counts, through the PDF's own text layer. Scanned PDFs without one are skipped.

items.label: Sync conflicts
items.title: Sync: never lose an edit made on two devices
items.lede: When the same note changes on two devices before they sync, 1.2.1 keeps only the later save. This branch keeps both.

blocks.label: What happens to a conflicting edit

rows.text: The newer version stays in place
The older one becomes a copy
rows.why: with the device name in its title

callouts.p: Anyone using Lumen on two Macs can lose an edit today, so this should ship as soon as it's ready, as 1.2.2.
The conflict banner has no close button, so it stays on the note forever. Add one, then this is ready.

items.label: Sharing links
items.title: Sharing: a read-only link to one note
items.lede: Share a single note as a link anyone can read, without an account. Links expire after 30 days.

a.text: Grocery list · shared by Sam · expires in 30 days

b.text: This link has expired. Ask Sam for a new one.

bullets: The app side is done: the share sheet and links that expire after 30 days.
There's no server yet to host the shared notes.

callouts.p: Hosting shared notes is the first thing Lumen would run on a server. Decide that on its own, then come back to this branch.

items.label: 1.3 launch page
items.title: The 1.3 launch page
items.lede: A page for 1.3 built around search: a short demo, three screenshots, and what's new.

callouts.p: It shows search, so publish it only once search is on main and 1.3 is out.

bullets: A 20-second search demo, muted and looping.
Three screenshots: the field, highlighted results, and a PDF match.
A short what's-new list, and the download button.
